mentions.description: An AI growth app that achieved signups but struggled to convert new users into active users, leading its builder to downgrade time on it; it is still used to dogfood on the builder's own projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://octoloops.com - AI growth app. I've downgraded my time on this as although I could get users to sign up, getting them to actually use the app hasn't worked out at all; new users won't reply to my nice founder emails either. Bit of a bummer because I invested quite a lot of effort but it just doesn't seem to be working. Ironically I still use it to dogfood on my own projects...

mentions.name: OctoLoops
mentions.description: OctoLoops is a marketing harness where users loop marketing activities such as posting to online communities or doing direct outreach, with human-in-the-loop review to balance being reasonable versus spammy. Its goal is to help people with the hard part of getting paying users now that building is easy.
mentions.problem: Building is now easy, but getting (paying) users is the hard part for people who build things.
mentions.audience: People building products who need help getting paying users
mentions.source_excerpt: The core idea is building is now easy so let's help people with the hard part: getting (paying) users! It's a marketing harness where you "loop" marketing activities like posting to online communities or direct outreach. Human in the loop so attempting to balance the usual tightrope of reasonableness and being spammy.
